reviews.text: Great experience from initial sales consult (David Martin), to quote, to answering a variety of questions, to quality of installation (Travis and Eldon) and explaining how to operate the mini splits. Great customer service.
reviews.author: Brian W.

reviews.text: Jon, Jeremy and Travis did a fantastic job installing my new heat pump. It looks good, it runs good and they left the house in clean, orderly condition which means a lot to me! I can always count on Martin's for doing a wonderful job.
reviews.author: Dara K.

reviews.text: We recently had a whole home steam humidifier installed by Martin Heating and Cooling. Michael did a great job explaining the system and what was needed. The installation went smoothly and the area was cleaned up nicely. Would recommend.
reviews.author: Rebecca S.
